remaining_open_items: Exact temperature/voltage derating implementation, charging limits and balancing network require reference binding.
Model ESR must name its time/frequency condition; one universal ESR is not supported.
Surge voltage and failure timing remain unsourced for this exact reference.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Unresolved electrical/reference/geometry binding and condition-specific current limits; stored energy and short-circuit heating are safety relevant. Resolution: Electrical/reference/geometry binding: the archived AVX SCC datasheet (entry document) gives an exact part whose body matches the 10 x 20 mm can, with C, tolerance, condition-tagged ratings (2.7 V at 65 C, 2.3 V at 85 C), DCL, three ESR maxima by condition and a peak current that p7 now defines (1-second interval). Binding SCCS20B505SRB explicitly (not Eaton HB ratings, not the 10 F default) closes the reference/geometry conflict. Condition-specific current limits: only the peak definition is sourced; continuous current is absent for this row, so the recipe carries ipk as a rating fact and its limitations state that no sustained-current acceptance exists. Stored energy and short-circuit current are stated as hazards, never as rated behaviour. The class default (10 F, 20 mohm, 2.5 V) is not used.
